title: Signature study: RSA alongside One-time pad
description: 1977 — RSA: RSA is a public-key cryptosystem whose security rests on the difficulty of factoring large integers. alongside One-time pad (1917), This Signature pairing study examines the two together as complementary tools in real systems. The one-time pad encrypts each message bit with a random key bit used exactly once, a scheme patented by Gilbert Vernam in 1917. Filed as JAH-CRY-000012 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
